speaker: Mirella
cn: Damián，这是你的工位，（递工牌）这是你的工牌。
en: Damián, this is your workstation. (Handing over the work badge) This is your work badge.

speaker: Damián
cn: 组长？我应聘的不是普通职员吗？
en: Team lead? Didn't I apply for an ordinary staff position?

speaker: Mirella
en: Good luck, Damián! You’ve got this!

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: （满意地看着工牌）组长就组长，工资肯定比普通员工的多。
en: (looking at the work ID with satisfaction) Team lead is great. The salary must be higher than that of ordinary employees.

speaker: 戒指（OS）
cn: （低沉，带回声）命运节点已记录。节点：信息安全部。命运馈赠——顶级黑客之能，此后数字世界再无屏障可阻你脚步。馈赠已赐。
en: (deep, echoing) Fate-node recorded. Node: Cybersecurity Department. Fate's offering—top-tier hacking mastery; from this day forth, no barrier in the digital world shall stand in your way. Offering granted.

speaker: Damián
cn: （喜）这可是个好东西！有了黑客能力，我岂不是能在部门里横着走了！
en: (delighted) This is awesome! With hacking skills like these, I’ll be unstoppable in the department!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （喘粗气）完蛋了，迟到了。【人名：Eloísa Roldán｜Damián前女友】

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （娇弱）组长你好，我是您的组员Eloísa。迟到了真是对不起，我昨天刚结婚，睡得太晚了。
en: (softly) Hello, team lead! I'm Eloísa, one of your team members. I'm really sorry for arriving late—I just got married yesterday and overslept.

speaker: Damián
en: (coldly) Married? You do enjoy lying, Eloísa.

speaker: Eloísa(VO)
cn: （震惊）他怎么知道？不对，这个声音是……
en: (Shocked) How did he know? No, this voice is...

speaker: 员工一
cn: （提醒）Eloísa，这是我们的新组长啊。难道，（来回打量）你们认识？
en: (Reminds) Eloísa, this is our new team lead. Could it be that—(glances around)—you knew each other?

speaker: Damián
cn: Eloísa，是我的前女友。昨天该结婚的时候却逃婚。按照公司规定，迟到并虚报原因，记严重警告，扣除当日绩效。
en: Eloísa is my ex-girlfriend. She walked out on our wedding yesterday. But rules are rules. Being late and lying about the reason earns you a serious warning and costs you today’s performance bonus.

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 谁允许你来这上班了？我不就是逃婚了吗？你故意让我难堪？
en: Who said you could work here? So I walked out on our wedding. Is this your way of getting back at me?

speaker: Damián
cn: 这是公司，不是你大喊大叫的地方！
en: We are at work. Behave yourself.

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （怒吼）Damián！除非你现在离职，否则我就不跟你结婚了！你这个渣男！
en: (Roaring) Damián! Unless you resign right now, I won't marry you! You're a total scumbag!
